info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Features: Virtual Extensions API
Read the List of Virtual Extensions

params.name: orgId
params.description: Unique identifier for the organization.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of virtual extensions returned to this maximum count. Default is 10.

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of matching virtual extensions. Default is 0.

params.name: order
params.description: Order the list of virtual extensions in ascending or descending order. Default is ascending.

params.name: extension
params.description: Filter the list of virtual extensions by extension number.

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: Filter the list of virtual extensions by phone number.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter the list of virtual extensions by name. This can be either first name or last name.

params.name: locationName
params.description: Filter the list of virtual extensions by location name.(Only one of the locationName, locationId, and OrgLevelOnly query parameters is allowed at the same time.)

params.name: locationId
params.description: Filter the list of virtual extensions by location ID.

params.name: orgLevelOnly
params.description: Filter the list of virtual extensions by organization level. If orgLevelOnly is true, return only the organization level virtual extensions.

Retrieve virtual extensions associated with a specific customer.

The GET Virtual Extensions API allows administrators to retrieve a list of virtual extensions configured within their organization. Virtual extensions enable users to dial extension numbers that route to external phone numbers, such as those of remote workers or frequently contacted clients.

items.docs:
Update Virtual Extension details for the given extension ID.

This API updates the configuration of an existing virtual extension identified by its unique extension ID. Administrators can modify fields such as the extension, associated phone number (in E.164 format), display name, and location etc.

Updating a Virtual Extension requires a full administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_write` and `identity:contacts_rw`.

params.name: extensionId
params.description: ID of the virtual extension.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Unique identifier for the organization.

items.docs:
Delete Virtual Extension using the extension ID.

This API permanently deletes a virtual extension from the organization. Once deleted, the extension will no longer route calls to the external phone number, and users won’t be able to reach it via the assigned extension.

Deleting a Virtual Extension requires a full administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_write` and `identity:contacts_rw`.

Retrieve Virtual Extension settings for the given Org.

This API retrieves the virtual extension mode settings configured for a given organization. Virtual extensions can operate in two modes: STANDARD and ENHANCED. The selected mode determines how the system handles routing and signaling for virtual extensions.

params.description: Unique identifier for the organization.

items.docs:
Update Virtual Extension details for the given extension ID.

This endpoint updates the virtual extension settings for an organization. It is primarily used to configure the operating mode for virtual extensions.
Modes determine how virtual extensions are assigned or managed within the system.

Updating a Virtual Extension requires a full administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_write`.

Validate external phone number for the given organization.

This API is designed to validate external phone numbers before they are assigned as virtual extensions for a customer.
It ensures that the provided numbers are properly formatted, eligible for use, and not already in use within the system.

params.name: locationId
params.description: Filter the list of virtual extension ranges by location ID. Only one of the `locationId` and `OrgLevelOnly` query parameters is allowed at the same time.

params.name: orgLevelOnly

items.docs:
Retrieves the list of Virtual Extension Ranges.

Virtual extension ranges integrate remote workers on a separate telephony system into Webex Calling and enable extension dialing. Using these ranges, you can define patterns that can be used to route calls at a location level or an organization level. You are allowed to define virtual extensions ranges in addition to individual virtual extensions.
This works in both Standard and Enhanced modes
